name: The October Nights
source:
Nolan is a detective. He likes to solve mysteries. He reads a book named "The Mystery of October Nights" and sets of to solve it.

[From [url=https://sujalchoudhari.itch.io/the-october-nights]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诺兰是一名侦探。他喜欢解开谜团。他读了一本名为《十月之夜之谜》的书，并开始解决这个问题。

[来自[url=https://sujalchoudhari.itch.io/the-october-nights]Itch.io[/url]]
